newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil shares seen mixed to lower, eyeing options.
newsitem.headline: Brazil shares seen mixed to lower, eyeing options.

text.p: * Banco do Brasil first half results due 1800 GMT
* BNDES to sell stake in Escelsa

Brazil shares were seen opening mixed to lower Monday, watching closely today's options expiry and Wall Street, where stock prices were expected to open mixed to lower after Friday's tumble, brokers said.
"The bolsa is likely to remain nervous today, taking its cue from Wall Street while options settle," said a senior trader.
On Friday, shares plunged to end down 4.78 percent due to steep drops in U.S. stocks and jostling between investors ahead of the options settlement.

Traders said they had expected most of Telebras options above the 140 reais strike price to be exercised but Friday's sharp losses are likely to discourage players as the company's preferred stock closed at 137 reais in the spot market.
Analysts also said they would pay attention to today's release of Banco do Brasil first half results.
The bank will hold a news conference at 1500 local/1800 GMT to announce its first positive result after posting heavy losses in 1995 and 1996.
They also said they would keep an eye on today's auction of the government's remaining stake in privatized Espirito Santo power utility Escelsa.
